passages.title: My day
paragraphs: I’m Aden. I often get up at 7 in the morning. Then I wash my face and brush my teeth. After I eat breakfast, I go to school at 7:30. I like my school. I can do many things at school. I can study, draw, write, run, jump, sing and dance with my classmates. I’m very happy!

passages.title: My family
paragraphs: Hello! I’m David. There are four people in my family. They are my father, my mother, my brother and I. My mother is a teacher. She’s short and thin. My father is a driver. He’s tall and fat. Tony is my brother. He’s five. He’s small. I’m nine today. I’m tall and thin. I like my family.

passages.title: Tom and Jenney
paragraphs: Danny: Is that tall boy Tom?
Ben: Yes, he’s only ten years old, but he’s very tall. Look at that lovely girl. Who is she?
Danny: She’s my little sister, Jenny. She’s five, but she can dance very well.
Ben: Wow! How beautiful! Your sister is five and you are…
Danny: I’m nine years old. I like to read books. So, I’m wearing a pair of glasses.
Ben: Ha…Ha…

passages.title: Dogs
paragraphs: Dogs are our best friends. Over thousands of years, men teach their dogs to do many kinds of work, besides guarding the home. As all know, sheepdogs are famous for their ability to control hundreds of sheep. Dogs can also help disabled people. A guide dog can lead its blind owner. Now some people teach dogs to turn on the light switches, open the fridge door and dial the telephone for their disabled owner. However, for many people, dogs are only pets for old and young members of family.

passages.title: Twins’ family
paragraphs: There are four people in the twins’ family. They are the twins and their parents. Sally and Sandy are twins, they are both ten. They are thin and tall. They look like each other. They are in the same class in Rainbow Primary School. They like studying very much. They not only work hard but also sing very well. Sally can play the piano, and Sandy can play the violin. Their father, Mr. Green, is a doctor. He is strong and tall. He always helps sick people. Mrs. Green is a teacher. She likes the children and the children like her very much. Sally and Sandy love their parents and their parents love them, too!

passages.title: My friend
paragraphs: Hi, I’m Lily. Annie is my good friend. She lives in a big house. She is nine years old. She has long curly hair and wears a pair of glasses. She is not very pretty but she is clever. She makes me laugh. We have a lot of fun. We play together. We read books together. We do our homework together. We are good friends.

passages.title: Famer and Snake
paragraphs: It’s very cold. The farmer works in the field. On his way, he sees a snake. The snake is frozen. It’s going to die. How poor the snake is! So the farmer picks up the snake and puts it into his coat. He tries to warm the snake. After a while, the snake isn’t cold. It bites the farmer with its sharp teeth. And the farmer is dead.

passages.title: Peter’s rabbit
paragraphs: Peter has a large room. There is a rabbit in his room. Peter’s rabbit is fluffy and soft. Look! It can run and jump. Peter’s rabbit likes Peter’s soup. The rabbit sits on the table and eats Peter’s soup.

passages.title: ABC garden
paragraphs: Today is a sunny day. It’s Saturday. I’m in the ABC garden. I see four boys and five girls. Two girls skip on the grass. Three girls fly kites. The boys ride bicycles. I see seven birds in the tree. They can sing. How happy I am!

passages.title: My Day
paragraphs: The Children’s Garden is near my home. It’s often crowded and noisy during the holidays. Children like it very much! Every weekend, I go there with my good friends. You can see the red seesaw, the blue slide and the orange swing in the children’s garden. Beth and Jerry like playing on the seesaw. Beth is up and Jerry is down. They like to play, up and down. Peter and I often slide on the slide. We can slide very fast. Danny and Alice sometimes play on the swing. They sing and swing happily. Bob and Tina often run around the garden with my dog. We feel very happy in the children’s garden

passages.title: In the park
paragraphs: It’s a sunny day today. The sun is shining, and the birds are singing. The sky is blue. There are some clouds in the sky. The birds fly in the sky. The children are in the park now. The park is big and nice. There are many beautiful flowers and green trees in the park. Tim and Rita are in the park. They smell the flower and ride bikes in the park. Tony and Lily see some lovey butterflies. The butterflies fly above the flowers. Tony and Lily run after the butterflies with their dog, Sam. How happy the children are in the park!

passages.title: Ada and Aden
paragraphs: Hello, I’m little Ada. I’m a little girl. I am two years old. I’m small and thin. My hair is short and curly. My eyes are big and my ears are small. I have a red dress. I can write very well. But I can’t skip. This is my big brother, Aden. He is older than me. He is ten years old. He can play badminton. I love my brother and he loves me, too.

passages.title: Late for school
paragraphs: One day, John is late for school again. The teacher is very angry. She asks John, “Why are you late for school every morning?” John looks sad. He tells the teacher that every time he comes to the corner a guidepost says, “School—Go Slowly.”

passages.title: Rabbit and wolf
paragraphs: Here comes a little rabbit. She’s picking mushrooms in the forest. A wolf comes. He is very hungry. He wants to eat the rabbit. When the wolf sees the rabbit, he is very happy. But the rabbit isn’t afraid of the wolf. She pretends to be poisoned by eating the mushrooms. She is crying. The wolf sees the rabbit and thinks that the rabbit is poisoned by the mushrooms. If he eats the rabbit, he will be poisoned too. So he runs away sadly. The little rabbit is very happy. She goes on picking mushrooms.

passages.title: Children’s Park
paragraphs: Today is Sunday. It is cloudy. There are many children in the park. They can see grass, trees and flowers in the park. They are beautiful. Look, Peter is riding a bicycle. Bob is eating an ice cream on the swing. Mary is playing on the seesaw with her friend Sam. Oh, a little cat is climbing up the jungle gym. It is funny. The children are having a good time.

passages.title: Lucy and Tommy
paragraphs: Lucy and Tommy are good friends. They go home together after school. When they are back home, Tommy says, “Let’s play a game. Lucy!” Lucy thinks for a while. She says, “Sorry! I must do my homework first.” Then Tommy plays games by himself. After a while, Tommy comes to see Lucy. “Let’s watch TV!” he says. “Sorry. I should read my book.” Lucy says. Then Tommy watches TV by himself. At last, Lucy finishes her homework, and she begins to play a game. How happy she is! She can do the things she likes now. But Tommy is sad, because he has to do his homework.

passages.title: My house
paragraphs: Hi! Let me tell you something about my beautiful house. I live in a nice and new building. The building has twenty floors. There are about forty families in the building. That’s to say, about a hundred people live in the building. My home is on the tenth floor. We have two bedrooms and a living room. They are big and clean. There are a lot of big trees and beautiful flowers around our building. I like looking out of the window in my room. I can see cars and buses running in the street. I can see people walking in the street, too. They look so small! I can also see a lot of tall buildings. I am happy to live in this beautiful neighborhood.

passages.title: The bus driver
paragraphs: The bus is very crowded. A man tries to get on, but no one cares about him. The man is very worried. He shouts loudly, “Hey, let me get on.” A young woman says, “It’s too crowded. Who do you think you are?” The man says angrily, “I’m the bus driver.”

passages.title: Cross the road
paragraphs: Today is sunny. Ben and Eddie go to the park. Now they are on the road. They see the red light. They can’t go. They wait beside the road. An old man comes. He can’t see. He wants to cross the road. Ben and Eddie stop the old man, “You can’t cross the road. Please wait.” The old man says, “Thank you.”

passages.title: The winter
paragraphs: My name is Sam. It’s winter now. It’s snowy. It’s very cold. I want a sweater and a scarf. I’m still cold. I want some hot milk. The milk is nice. I like to skip in the room. Now I feel warm. But I’m hungry. I want some bread. The bread is nice. I like it.

passages.title: Twins’ bedroom
paragraphs: This is the twins’ bedroom. It is a nice room. The two beds look the same. This bed is Lily’s and that is Lucy’s. The twins have one desk and two chairs. Their clock, books and pencil boxes are on the desk. Their schoolbags are behind the chairs. Some nice flowers are on the desk. Some nice pictures are on the wall. Is there a kite? Yes. It’s under Lily’s bed. The bedroom is very nice.

passages.title: About Peter
paragraphs: I’m Peter. I am a boy. I am eight. I am tall. I can fly a kite. I have a purple rope and a yellow kite. I don’t like apples, but I like pink peaches. I don’t like singing, but I like reading and dancing. I like playing toy cars and football too. I like hippos. They are fat. They have big mouths. They like eating grass.

passages.title: Tina’s bedroom
paragraphs: Tina looks around her new bedroom happily. She has just moved into her new house. She likes blue and pink. The bed, the desk and the chair are blue. The quilt, the sheet and the pillow are pink. There is a plant on the desk. On the right wall, there is a star clock. On the left wall, there is a picture of flowers. Above the bed, there are two photos of her family. There is a big cupboard in the bedroom. Open it and see. There are so many
toys: dolls, teddy bears, a magic book, a toy rabbit. Tina likes her nice bedroom very much.

passages.title: 短文 24
paragraphs: I’m Kitty. I’m nine. Today is Mother’s Day. I have a good idea. I give a gift to Mum. It’s a carnation. It’s red. It’s very beautiful. And I write a letter too. I write “I love you, Mum.” on the letter. Mum is very happy. I am happy too.

passages.title: 短文 25
paragraphs: Hello, I am a dog. I am Spotty. I am big. I am black and white. I can run fast and jump high. I like eating bones. They are nice. I don’t like eating grass. In summer, I like sleeping under the trees. I have a friend. Her name is Kitty. She’s a white cat. It likes fish. We like playing together. We are happy.

passages.title: 短文 26
paragraphs: Hello! I’m Danny. I’m a boy. I’m tall. I’m ten years old. I like animals very much. Today I’m in the zoo. I can see a monkey. The monkey is small and brown. It can ride a bicycle. What do the monkeys like eating? Oh, they like eating bananas. I can hear the tigers. They are big and strong. They like eating meat.

passages.title: 短文 27
paragraphs: Hi, I’m Helen. I like the four seasons. Spring is warm. Trees are green. I like the flowers, grass and trees in the spring. Summer is hot. The sun is red. I like swimming in the water. Autumn is cool and nice. I like flying a kite in the garden. Winter is cold. The wind blows and blows. I like skating on the ice.

passages.title: 短文 28
paragraphs: Today is Sunday. It’s fine. Kitty and her mother go to the park. There are many beautiful flowers in it. Some are pink. Some are purple. Kitty like the pink flowers. She wants to pick the flowers. “Don’t pick the flowers.” Mother says. There are some butterflies flying in the park. Kitty likes them very much.

passages.title: 短文 29
paragraphs: Today is Kitty’s birthday. She is eight years old. Her father gives her a present. It is an animal. It is white. It goes “meow…meow…”. Touch and feel it. It is soft and smooth. Kitty likes it very much. Kitty’s friends come to her birthday party. They sing and dance together. They eat the cake and drink the juice. They are happy.

passages.title: 短文 30
paragraphs: There is an old woman in England. She doesn’t like children at all, but she loves cats. She has black cats and white cats. She has mother cats and baby cats. So the children like to come to her hose. They come to play with the cats. More and more cats come to the old woman’s house. Soon there are too many cats and the old woman can’t feed them at all. Then she has an idea. “The children love my cats.” She thinks. So she gives each child a cat. Then she is happy, the children are happy, and the cats are happy too, because they each have a home.

passages.title: 短文 31
paragraphs: There are many kinds of horses in the world. But one of them is not for you to ride. It doesn’t live on land, but in the sea. Its head looks like the head of a horse, so people call it a “sea horse”. In fact, the sea horse is a small fish. It likes to live in warm water. A sea horse always stands up in the water when it swims. Father sea horses carry the eggs to keep them safe in their pouches until they are hatched. When the eggs are hatched, the baby sea horses swim away.

passages.title: 短文 32
paragraphs: There are four seasons in a year. We can see beautiful flowers and butterflies in spring. It’s warm and wet. In summer, the sun is red and hot. the weather is hot. We like going to the beach to swim in the sea. Autumn is cool. The wind blows and blows. We can see some brown leaves on the ground. Winter is cold outside, but we can make the snowman and play with the snowball in that season.

passages.title: 短文 33
paragraphs: This is forest. There are many animals in it. They are elephants, giraffes, tigers, bears, zebras. The elephants are big and gray. They like eating bananas. The tigers are brown and black. They like eating meat. The hippo is gray and big. The hippo’s mouth is big, too. It likes eating grass. The rabbit is white and small. The rabbit’s eyes are red. It likes eating carrots and grass. They are happy.

passages.title: 短文 34
paragraphs: Joy and I are good friends. Joy has got two rabbits. One is grey and the other is white. They can jump high. They like to eat carrots and grass. Joy likes them very much. I have got a pet, too. It is a parrot. It very clever, so I can call it “Clever”. It can say “Hello” and “Bye-bye” to you. It can sing, too. Cleve is also very naughty. It sometimes wakes me up at midnight. But everyone in my family likes it and I am sure you will like it, too.

passages.title: 短文 35
paragraphs: There is a wolf in the forest. Every day he goes around to look for food. There are many sheep and deer in the forest. They are all afraid of him. One day the wolf sees a group of sheep. He tries to catch them. The father and mother sheep stand together to fight him. So the wolf can do nothing. Later the sheep have a quarrel and they don’t stay with each other. When the wolf sees this, he is happy. He catches them and eats them one by one. At last he eats all the sheep.
